name: DIVISION
detailed_description:
DIVISION is a 2.5D side-scrolling sci-fi adventure game that tells the story of a girl named Yi, who embarks on a journey to find her family as the world falls into ruin.

The home we once knew is now being devoured by an unknown force.

Mysterious mechanical beings have descended upon the land, and familiar life has been shattered in an instant.

Faced with these sudden invaders, Yi has no choice but to leave the land that once sheltered her.

She doesn’t know how difficult the journey will be;

She doesn’t know the outside world is far more chaotic than she imagined;

She doesn’t know what truths lie behind the unknown.

All she knows is that she must find her family.

Game Features

🌌 Sci-Fi Adventure in 2.5D

A fresh side-scrolling experience that blends classic controls with innovative mechanics.

🎨 Unique Art Style & Immersive Puzzles

Striking visuals combined with deeply integrated environmental puzzles create an immersive journey of exploration.

🧩 Carefully Crafted Levels & Mechanics

Every element is designed to feel distinct—no repetition, no filler—ensuring a constantly fresh and challenging experience.

💭 Emotion-Driven Narrative

Through subtle storytelling and atmospheric presentation, players are drawn into Yi’s inner world and emotional journey.

🎮 Minimalist Controls, Maximum Focus

No complex tutorials—progress through intuition and observation. Just focus on the experience.

🌍 Explore a Bizarre and Surreal World

Confront the unknown, witness surreal marvels, and gradually uncover the secrets behind this collapsing world.

All settings and worldbuilding in this game are fictional. Locations and events depicted are purely imagined.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11（64-bit）
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 or AMD Radeon RX 580 (4GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: VR Not supported
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11（64-bit）
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Super or AMD Radeon RX 6600（6GB VRAM）
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10(SSD recommended) GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: VR Not supported
